mainEntity.name: What permits are required for second-story deck construction in the service area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building a second-story deck in Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, or Emeryville typically requires obtaining specific permits from your local building department. This usually includes a building permit, and depending on the design and site, may also involve zoning or planning review. Hometelligent Inc. can assist with understanding and securing the necessary permits for your specific project, which is a critical first step before construction can begin.
